brief: US equities closed higher on Thursday, which the note links to rates stabilizing after commentary from Fed Governor Waller: SPX +106bps to 7747, NDX +116bps to 29,482, RTY +51bps to 2968. Software outperformed semis, with AI Software +536bps against AI Semis +25bps after AVGO fell 2.7% on earnings. Europe showed sector dispersion, Media, Autos and Financials higher, Staples, Luxury and Defense lower. On seasonality, in midterm years the S&P 500 has returned a median 0% from the start of August through Election Day and a median 6% in the following three months, from which the note lists five midterm basket ideas: long ACA-exposed, renewables and grid, and government-spending exposed ex-defense and drug-makers, short drug-makers and defense beneficiaries. Goldman forecasts August payrolls at 40k versus consensus 55k, unemployment unchanged at 4.1%, and average hourly earnings +0.4% month-over-month, above consensus on calendar effects. European fundamental long/short managers were up 2.0% in August while degrossing, with Europe the second most sold region after DM Asia on long selling. Ratings: Vodafone double upgraded to Buy on accelerating ROIC, Cellnex cut to Sell, Neste upgraded to Buy.
